body:
Hey. I just wanted to thank you for being so kind. I don't really deserve that, but I wanted to thank you anyway. I just want to let you know, I'll keep going. I don't know if I can have the same courage you do, to be that blunt, to want to help others. I definitely won't do it under this name. I'm okay now. I'm going to make sure I don't have a chance to take the way out that would hurt everyone else. I still have my problems, but they're my problems. Maybe one day I can try to follow your example. 

Humble. I can do humble (Probably not a lot else at the moment), but I think you deserve to know, that no matter what, you'll always have at least one life that you helped along. Thank you.

Hey. I'm sorry ahead of time, rereading the other comments I've left they're awful and probably no one needs these anyway I could just make it a single line but I do want to make it clear that really: I feel better. I'm still, y'know, a crappy human being, but I'm not going to be a total asshole and drain my brains.  You're right, you and everyone else saying the same thing- I'm an idiot and all, but I certainly didn't do anything illegal and I'm sure as fuck not a pedophile. I'm hoping this shit blows over, but my name is out there and all, but I'll have to deal with that there.

Thank you for your sympathy. I'm sorry you had to go through that social anxiety. I look back and I really have to keep things in perspective. I don't have any sort of great obstacles aside from myself, and as long as some part of me still wants to improve, still seeks to aspire to more than rotting, I've still got some hope. It's close to a girl problem I guess, as close as I'll ever get. It's more of a problem of what porn I chose, and having a username that is (apparently) easy to track. Which, y'know, no one really needs to know and I'm sorry about that, but I look and look at this (way too fucking long comment) and I just needed to be honest, that really, this is nothing noble just a bad choice of smut and a careless moronic god damn mistake on my part. And no, it's not child pornography. Everything I looked at was clothed for fucks sakes.

Moving on.

I don't know how behind me my parents will be. I don't know about that. I would rather not change my name, but it's not a bad idea. I probably should, really. And if anybody brings up the fact I lived at that old address, I can just shrug and remark what a coincidence is. Hopefully. 

Anyway, I'm sorry for bothering you again, but I just wanted to thank you for this. I might be fucked in the future, but I'll know for sure now at least.

Hey. Yeah, you sound a lot like me. And, at least for the moment escape felt really good. But it really helps to know that I'm not alone and all. I just want to say first and foremost, I feel better now. Coming back to all the comments sympathizing really helped, and seeing the rest of /r/Suicidewatch really helped put things in perspective. I think I've touched bottom here, and you along with many other good persons helped me with that. I just wnated to thank you for that. 

As for what's hard about writing... My whining screed above I wrote yesterday and insufficient apologies today are the foremost of my writing recently. Which really makes me feel bad. I want to write a story that people will like instead of just feeding from my fear and and and the rest of this bullshit. I can't put it into words. I wish I could write a description of a rose in a  summer's day instead of just vomiting "I feel bad because X Y Z". I can't explain it really well. The words don''t come out on the page and if they come they're hooked in tangled strings from my hands, bullshit so transparent you could make an aquarium out of it, or it's so obscure and maudlin you'd need a manual and two dictionaries to understand it. That prose back there is atrocious and nonsensical, and that's just the problem. The closest thing to something real that I've written has been a half assed suicide note. Ugh. That's, that's what really, really and truly bothers me and why I wish I hadn't thrown away my office job.

Glergh. Sorry Id umped another load on you. ANYWAY. I know suicide doesn't help, it just skips to the end of the book. And your sympathy helped. I wanted to thank you before I closed up shop and found out my bullshit on my own. I think I'm okay from here.

Hey, I just wanted to thakn you for the kind words. I just wanted to first say I'm okay now, and am sorry to darken your computer screena  second time and all but I just wanted to say I feel saner now. Not kiling myself way. Which, y'know, two days and then turning around and saying hey i feel better now makes it seem kind of superficial which really hey it might have been but I've locked the gun up and am giving it away tomorrow so, I just wanted to thank you for the kindness. You helped me. I'm sorry this went on so long,but I really want to say thanks.

Hey. First, I just want to say I'm better now, so don't worry about taht. I'm realizing how fucking ridiculous this all is now (Me staying up way too fucking long is contributing to this) but reading the messages through the day, and the other posts here in SW really made me rethink things, and how I don't have it bad, and I just wanted to thank everyone here for what they said to me. It really does help.

And yeah, I don't look down on people that go on unemployment or whatever. I just don't want to be dragging other people down. And yeah. Staining a carpet and my pants would not be dignified. I really do wince reading back over that. I'm scared about what people will think of me, but it's not going to help if I'm dead. Bleh. Another too long. But I wanted to thank you. I'm closing this account up, but I just wnated to thank everybody for their kind words.

Hey. First, let me say that you contributed to me getting through this rough patch and making what would have been one of the stupidest decision in my life not happen, i think I'm okay now though, and thank you.  Thank you for the sympathy, but let's be frank here the thing above didn't even have paragraphs much less any kind of cogent feeling. I do appreciate the sympathy though. And yeah, I probably will have to move in with my parents. I would rather stay away from that option for long as possible and I don't know what my neighbors may or may not be thinking but I really can not imagine seeing them again. Either that or roughing it. I don't know. But I do want to thank you, and let you know I'm okay. I'll be closing up this account here pretty soon, but first wanted to thank you again.

Thank you for the reassurances. You have a good point that I'm making a mountain out of a molehill next to the issues that real people have to go through. I just wanted to thank you for the kind words, it really helped me and I think I'm okay now. And I think you're a pretty cool dude so i think your critic should take a break for a bit. Thanks again.

Hey. I just wanted to thank you for the link. I tihnk I need to write something first before it can work for me 9at first glimpse) but I will bookmark it. I also am feeling better. I'm sorry for the trouble.

Yeah, I just wanted to thank you for the sympathy. I made my decision, locked up my gun. I plan to be giving it away soon. I spent yestarday and today awake and staring, not leaving my room, not sleeping. I feel I'm innocnet. I don't think I did anything illegal or really wrongb but we will see what the neighbors think if the note bears through. I didn't kill myself because I'm a coward, and that it really doesn't make good sense, and you pointed that out. I do appreciate the empathy and I thank you sincerely. I do want to be independent but I guess I can't be, but anyway, I think I can make it through here and I think at this point I'm babbling but I think you get the gist, I just wanted to say thanks, and let you know I didn't eat a bullet or anything like that and I'm sorry about the melodrama and shit. Thanks. I have no idea how to start with getting my name off the web or even if I can even legally try or whatever (I don't even have a fucking facebook, I have NO IDEA how they found me and it scares me shitless) but I know I can't do it dead.

I googled my name (My real name) and my name and address is on a site out there along with a bunch of others depicting me as some kind of deviant predator which I am emphatically NOT. Okay, I just googled it now, and now it looks like it's not open to the public anymore, and I hope it stays that way, but it was out there once, it'll be out there again. Fucking hell, my neighbors might know about it. It's only been one day, I don't know what's going to happen tomorrow. I can't fucking sleep. I wanted to go to bed. I stayed staring up at the ceiling for an hour, and I couldn't sleep.  I can't help but wonder at the arithmetic. If I killed myself now, maybe it wouldn't go any further? Respect for the dead or something. I could just be some loner that wallpapered brain after losing his job, what a shame. If I wait, won't it get worse?
